svg.title: Harvest-to-dry-room handoff workflow
svg.desc: A harvest handoff workflow preserving source and output identity, destination, quantity, condition and environment, sanitation and hold status, deviations, authorized actions, escalation, unresolved conditions and next action.
svg.text: Harvest handoff: transfer facts, not just material

g.text: Receiving role must be able to reconstruct:
1. Authorization / source identity — room, plant, batch or lot
2. Output identity / destination — container or harvest lot + verified rack/location
3. Quantity — outgoing and receiving values, units and reconciliation status
4. Condition / environment — identified rack/lot observations at the correct scope
5. Sanitation / hold — clean handling plus isolated or held material
6. Deviation / discrepancy — identity, quantity, destination, contamination or equipment issue
7. Action / escalation — authorized step taken and role notified
8. Next action — follow-up required by receiving shift or qualified reviewer
Partial completion is valid. A hold, discrepancy or unresolved question stays visible rather than being converted into a guessed release/disposition decision.
